description: Model what fails if an employee, service, integration, vendor, or resource disappears.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: Disaster-recovery plans are written but never felt, and an interactive blast-radius simulator makes resilience visceral — tabletop exercises are a real enterprise ritual with real budgets. $20/user/mo is fair. The enterprise tabletop module is the wedge into the compliance budget.

notes.change: auto-run scrolled #result under the fixed header; added scroll-margin-top so results clear it
graph nodes were invisible (shared kit sets border-color on SVG rects, a no-op); promoted each node's severity color to a real SVG stroke

notes.note: Scenario select re-runs blast-radius sim; zero errors.

notes.change: New 'Copy incident brief' exports severity, customers, revenue, open gaps and mitigations as a paste-ready text brief.
